# djs-core

> Framework for discord.js developpement

## Docs

- [Djs-Core](/index.md): The first type-safe Discord bot framework
- [Installation](/getting-started/installation.md): Get started with djs-core.
- [Project Structure](/getting-started/project-structure.md): How djs-core organizes your bot's code.
- [Interactions](/interaction/index.md): Learn how to create and manage Discord interactions with djs-core.
- [Commands](/interaction/commands.md): Learn how to create slash commands with djs-core.
- [Context Menus](/interaction/context-menus.md): User and Message commands available from the Discord right-click menu.
- [Event Listeners](/interaction/events.md)
- [Components](/components/index.md): Learn how to create and manage reusable interaction components with djs-core.
- [Buttons](/components/buttons.md): Creating and handling button interactions with djs-core.
- [Modals](/components/modals.md): Handling modal submissions and data entry in djs-core.
- [String Select Menus](/components/string-select-menus.md): Learn how to create and use string select menu components with djs-core.
- [User Select Menus](/components/user-select-menus.md): Learn how to create and use user select menu components with djs-core.
- [Role Select Menus](/components/role-select-menus.md): Learn how to create and use role select menu components with djs-core.
- [Channel Select Menus](/components/channel-select-menus.md): Learn how to create and use channel select menu components with djs-core.
- [Mentionable Select Menus](/components/mentionable-select-menus.md): Learn how to create and use mentionable select menu components with djs-core.
- [Bundle](/bundle/index.md): Learn about bundling and building your Discord bot with djs-core.
- [Plugins](/essentials/plugins.md): Extend your bot with the powerful djs-core plugin system.
- [Cron Tasks](/essentials/events-tasks.md): How to run scheduled tasks in djs-core.
- [User Config](/essentials/user-config.md): Load bot-tunable settings from config.json with full TypeScript types.
- [Configuration](/essentials/configuration.md): Everything you need to know about configuring your djs-core bot.
- [Lint](/essentials/check.md): Catch djs-core anti-patterns with djs-core check.
- [Testing](/essentials/testing.md): Test commands and interactions with @djs-core/testing and bun:test.
- [Plugins-Marketplace](/plugins-marketplace.md)
